text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One gloomy morning in the lead up to the Arima Kinen, I head to my office to plan out a training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're here already?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I open the door, Hishi Amazon is busy at work decorating the room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, y'know… It's the twenty-fifth, right? I wanted to surprise you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I figured it'd be fun to walk into your office and boom! Winter wonderland.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's all right. I didn't plan this well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I had no idea you would come in so early.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is going to be the backdrop for Hishi Amazon's huge showdown with Narita Brian this year.
choice_data_list: I wanted to make sure you'd be prepared, so…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh… I, uh… Hey, I really appreciate that. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm really excited for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She smiles bashfully as she says it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Man, I nearly forgot to give you this. You've gotta open a present, eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pull off the wrapping to find she's gifted me a neck warmer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I quickly try putting it on, but…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you doing, Teach? It goes around your stomach, not your neck.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What am I going to do with you? Come on, hold still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She pulls the stretchy fabric of the belly warmer wide and shimmies it down my torso.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Maybe it needs to go a little lower? Yeah, there we go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sweet, the size is perfect! Looks good on you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It comes with a pocket on the inside for those disposable heat packs. That should come in handy when it gets really cold.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's chilly sittin' out there from the spectator seats, right? I don't want my partner to catch a cold!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What a thoughtful gift. I'll be sure to make good use of it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So, um, about your present…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I feel strangely self-conscious because of all the weird things they were saying.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's just… My dorm residents kept makin' fun of me while I was knitting the thing!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student A
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you knitting a scarf? You're so talented!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Thanks, this is supposed to be a present for someone.

text_block_list.name: Miho Student B
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Is it for your special someone?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student A
text_block_list.text: Wait, no waaay! I mean, she's making it by hand, so it has to be!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha—as if! S-stop runnin' your mouths, you dummies!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You know what? Forget it! Just take this already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the box to find a hand-knit scarf with a fine and intricate pattern on it. It's so like her to make something like this.
choice_data_list: Thank you. I promise to treasure it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I quickly put it around my neck. The length is perfect, and it's soft to the touch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa. It suits you a lot better than I expected it to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This day with Hishi Amazon is one to remember.
